seasons.description: The season finale just broke the internet — absolute peak television you must stream tonight.
seasons.overview: The Black and Green factions lock into an all-out, relentless struggle for the Iron Throne. As dragons and armies clash across the realm, Westeros witnesses the devastating consequences of total war.

seasons.description: Just dropped two days ago and Reddit is already losing its mind over it.
seasons.overview: Four egocentric friends who run a neighborhood Irish pub in Philadelphia try to find their way through the adult world of work and relationships. Unfortunately, their warped views and precarious judgments often lead them to trouble, creating a myriad of uncomfortable situations that usually only get worse before they get better.

seasons.description: Action cinema quality at home — season four is trending everywhere for good reason.
seasons.overview: Based on "Gone Tomorrow," when a chance encounter with a distraught stranger on a subway goes horribly wrong, Jack Reacher is drawn into a complex and deadly game that pits him against ruthless foes from the highest echelons of power.

seasons.description: The internet's comfort show returns with a fresh twist everyone is arguing about.
seasons.overview: In season four, Ted returns to Richmond, taking on his biggest challenge yet: coaching a second division women's football team. Throughout the course of the season, Ted and the team learn to leap before they look, taking chances they never thought they would.

seasons.description: Brand new release dominating anime forums — pulse-pounding thrills from start to finish.
seasons.overview: After the Li Tianchen incident came to an end, the Time Photo Studio returned to a superficial calm. However, the news of Xia Fei's disappearance once again plunged everyone into the crossroads of fate. With Vein's return and Qiao Ling's awakening powers, Cheng Xiaoshi and Lu Guang gradually uncover the secrets of the Bahati fire case. Cheng Xiaoshi's father, Cheng Weimin, and mother, Shao Yuanyuan, also seemed to have intricate connections to it. As the investigation deepens, Liu Xiao, from a mysterious organization, begins his actions, and the intervention of Bridon police officer Jae adds uncertainty to this quest for the truth.

seasons.description: Fresh on Netflix and currently sitting atop the trending comedy charts this week.
seasons.overview: Will, the nervous and unqualified heir to an auto repair chain, attempts to turn his father’s business around despite constant torture from his cousin and now employee, Shane.

seasons.description: High-stakes spy action that has social media buzzing all week long.
seasons.overview: In Season Three, hidden networks, foreign operatives, and personal betrayals collide. Joe walks the line between duty and home as unseen forces circle her world. Patterns appear where they shouldn't, names vanish, and paths rearrange. Guided by Kaitlyn and Westfield, Joe confronts enemies operating in the shadows, leaving her to reckon with a war that now reaches into every part of her life.

seasons.description: Non-stop action and high ratings — K-thriller fans on TikTok are obsessed.
seasons.overview: Season 2 returns with Jian in control of the weapons shop, Jinman returned from the dead, and BABYLON well and truly on the backfoot. Working to keep Jian safe, Jinman will take the fight to BABYLON's door, but the mercenary organization won't go down easily. Humiliated, BABYLON will bring in help from overseas and unleash a new wave of deadly assassins to rebuild their ranks and exact their revenge.

seasons.description: Sci-fi at its absolute peak — episodic storytelling done right.
seasons.overview: In the fourth season, the crew of the U.S.S. Enterprise—led by Captain Christopher Pike—embarks on a series of thrilling and emotional adventures across the stars. As they journey to strange new worlds, they battle inner demons and external threats, encounter colorful new characters, reunite with familiar faces and confront terrifying aliens. Through it all, they strive to embrace a bright, hopeful future.

seasons.description: Pure nostalgic perfection that critics and fans alike cannot stop praising.
seasons.overview: Season 2 continues with the heroic mutant team of X-Men, divided and thrown across different eras in time as they struggle to navigate their return home. Meanwhile, back in the 1990s, suspicious foes and new strains of mutant intolerance are on the rise in the wake of the X-Men's absence.

seasons.description: Masterclass sci-fi tension that will keep you up way past your bedtime.
seasons.overview: Season three reveals an origin story set centuries earlier, while continuing the saga of a dystopian society of 10,000 people living underground under mysterious circumstances. In the present, Juliette Nichols survives her forced "cleaning" but returns with memory loss as the silo recovers from rebellion and faces a dangerous new threat. Meanwhile, in the "Before Times," journalist Helen Drew and Congressman Daniel Keene uncover a conspiracy that pulls them into a chain of events with catastrophic, irreversible consequences.

seasons.description: The beloved animated sci-fi hit returns with sharp comedy and endless charm.
seasons.overview: Brace yourselves... The future is about to get a whole lot stranger! It's a non-stop onslaught of swaggering space pirates, lab-grown meats, sexy scams... plus the shocking return of Dr. Zoidberg's lost love! You didn't see that coming, prior to being told about it just now!

seasons.description: Gritty zombie action that fan forums are calling the best season yet.
seasons.overview: In season three, Maggie and Negan finally put aside their differences to build the first thriving community in Manhattan since the apocalypse, but when chaos in the city begins to arise, they are forced to question: have they learned from their old wounds or will their dark past spell doom for the entire city?

seasons.series_name: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
seasons.description: A hilarious sci-fi comedy fresh on HBO Max that demands a binge-watch.
seasons.overview: Comic book store owner Stuart Bloom is tasked with restoring reality after he breaks a device built by Sheldon and Leonard, accidentally bringing about a multiverse Armageddon. Stuart is aided in this quest by his girlfriend Denise, geologist friend Bert and quantum physicist/all-around pain in the ass Barry Kripke. Along the way, they meet alternate-universe versions of characters we’ve come to know and love from The Big Bang Theory. As the title implies, things don’t go well.

seasons.description: Gritty crime thriller making waves among critics and mystery lovers.
seasons.overview: A reformed criminal is forced to confront her past and return to illicit activities for one final job, hoping to secure her freedom and leave her former life behind for good.

seasons.description: Sharp, stylish, and engaging — the origin story taking over Prime Video.
seasons.overview: Before Elle Woods was a fish-out-of-water at Harvard, we meet her in 1995 in the tumultuous waters of high school where she encounters tricky friendships, forbidden romance, and questionable fashion choices. In this unexpected chapter of her adolescence, we learn about the experiences that shaped Elle into the iconic young woman we've come to know and love.

seasons.series_name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
seasons.description: Witty satirical comedy making a splash across social media this summer.
The mystery thriller everyone on Netflix is binge-watching in a single sitting.
seasons.overview: An innocent father serves a life sentence for the murder of his own son. When he receives evidence that his son my still be alive, he is determined to break out of prison to discover the truth.

seasons.description: Nicolas Cage brings unmatched style in this dark, noir-infused comic book series.
seasons.overview: Private investigator Ben Reilly is hired on a couple of straightforward cases... until mobsters, monsters, and a mysterious femme fatale spin a web that brings him face to face with his former life as New York's only superhero: The Spider.

seasons.description: Multiversal mayhem continues — Rick and Morty delivers top-tier sci-fi laughs.
seasons.overview: Season 9 is all certified bangers. No AI slop! Just Grade A organic slop, made by real humans with real human traits like back hair and cysts. Please watch, or we'll have neglected our families for nothing.

seasons.description: Psychological thriller intensity that will leave you on the edge of your seat.
seasons.overview: A storm is coming for two happily married attorneys when a notorious killer from their past gets out of prison.

seasons.description: Western drama fans are fueling huge debate around this intense new expansion.
seasons.overview: Beth Dutton and Rip Wheeler are striking out on their own, and relocating for a new adventure. Their ward, Carter, is along for the ride, and – despite serious distractions – Beth and Rip work hard to ensure he becomes the man he’s meant to be. Just after the events of the Yellowstone series finale, follow Beth and Rip as they take on a 7,000-acre ranch in South Texas. Even with all of its beautiful landscapes and peaceful lifestyle, the pair run into hiccups trying to survive in the area, including a ruthless rival ranch run by a wealthy owner.

seasons.description: Spooky dark comedy with a unique tone that gained a huge cult following.
seasons.overview: Widow's Bay is a quaint island town 40 miles off the coast of New England. But something lurks beneath the surface. Mayor Tom Loftis is desperate to revive his struggling community. There's no Wi-Fi, spotty cellular reception and he must contend with superstitious locals who believe their island is cursed. He wants these people to respect him. They don't. They think he is soft and cowardly. And he is. But Loftis is determined to build a better future for his teenage son and turn the island into a tourist destination. Miraculously, he succeeds: tourists are finally coming. Unfortunately, the locals were right. After decades of calm, the old stories that seemed too ludicrous to be true start happening again.

seasons.description: Romance and sports combine into the ultimate guilty pleasure binge.
seasons.overview: The series depicts the elite ice hockey team, and the women in their lives, as they grapple with love, heartbreak, and self-discovery — forging deep friendships and enduring bonds while navigating the complexities that come with transitioning into adulthood.

seasons.description: Darkly funny thriller that delivers unexpected twists and clever comedy.
seasons.overview: A newly divorced mom falls down a dangerous rabbit hole of blackmail, murder and youth soccer.

seasons.description: Tense international thriller for mystery enthusiasts seeking a dark new watch.
seasons.overview: Sylvia van Maele, officier van justitie in Den Haag, bundelt haar krachten met Lars van de FIOD in de strijd tegen financiële misdaad: een schaduwwereld vol brievenbusfirma's, doodlopende paper trails en internationale belastingregels die gebogen en gebroken worden. Wanneer de grens tussen haar persoonlijke en professionele leven vervaagt, moet Sylvia op haar intuïtie vertrouwen om te overleven.

seasons.description: Nineteen seasons in and still delivering procedural suspense that keeps fans hooked.
seasons.overview: As the BAU investigates a string of chilling new cases, Elias Voit embarks on a path to atone for his past. His newfound infamy inadvertently awakens their most formidable nemesis yet, The Fan. Precise, calculating, and relentlessly dangerous, this UnSub pushes the BAU to the brink and back under the shadow of Elias Voit. But how far will The Fan go to prove his superiority over his idol?

seasons.description: Fun for the whole family — animated classic continuing its legendary run.
seasons.overview: Follow the aquatic adventures of a yellow sea sponge named SpongeBob who lives in a pineapple under the sea. When SpongeBob gets together with his friends in Bikini Bottom, there's always nautical nonsense to be found!

seasons.description: Kid-friendly favorite returning with fresh adventures for family night.
seasons.overview: The PAW Patrol is on a roll with adventures that take the pups from the prehistoric wilds of Dino Island to the rock-climbing heights of Rescue Mountain. Along the way, they’ll team up with new friends–from a speedy racing pooch to the legendary Abominable Snow Pup–proving that for this team, no job is too big, no pup is too small!

seasons.description: Divisive spin-off sparking fiery online debates — hate-watch or love it, everyone's talking.
seasons.overview: In the winter of 1985, snow blankets the town and the horrors of the Upside Down are finally fading. Our heroes Eleven, Mike, Will, Dustin, Lucas, and Max have settled back into a normal life of D&D, snowball fights, and quiet days. But beneath the ice, something terrifying has awakened. Could it be from the Upside Down? From the depths of Hawkins Lab? Or from somewhere else entirely? Our heroes must race to solve this mystery and save Hawkins in this untold story set in the Stranger Things universe.
